notes: Genuinely thin after real effort, same shape as Auto Mechanics but with an even weaker outcome: Nigeria's phone-repair YouTube space (GSM Repairers Association members, Computer Village technicians) is entirely repair-TECHNIQUE content — flashing, FRP bypass, hardware fixes — real and valuable to a repairer's skill, but not business education. A promising blog lead (cellsmartpos.com, a POS software company with genuinely relevant articles on repair-shop pricing and inventory) could not get its RSS feed confirmed. On books: every 'free' PDF found was either a low-quality aggregator of uncertain authorization, or required sharing the site on social media and emailing the operator directly in exchange for a copy — neither meets the bar for a clean free resource, so none were used. Worth a fresh attempt later with different search terms; this is an honest 0/0/0, not a skipped category.
